## Verification

List exact commands and results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant tests.
- [ ] Go files are formatted and both affected modules pass tests.
- [ ] Documentation matches public behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, runtime state, or generated debris is included.
- [ ] Third-party additions include provenance and complete license notices.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.
